Yaxel Lendeborg put up the highest-scoring game by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry!
Lendeborg finished with a career-high and game-high 37 points on 13-for-19 shooting, adding 6 assists and 6 three-pointers. It’s the most points by a Warriors rookie in a single game since Curry scored 42 on April 14, 2010.
37 PTS (career-high, game-high)
6 AST
6 3PM
13-19 FG
